about.heading: About Us
about.description: With over a decade of experience in digital marketing, I've had the privilege of working with 200+ businesses across Canada and the United States — from small local businesses to large publicly traded enterprises. My client roster spans CPG brands, brick-and-mortar retail, e-commerce, software companies, consultants, medical professionals, and real estate agents, among others. Across those engagements, I've helped generate over $500 million USD in revenue for clients through highly targeted, performance-driven digital strategies. I'm the founder and CEO of multiple marketing agencies, and I bring that same operator-level thinking to every client relationship.

overview.headline: The Opportunity
overview.subheadline: Dr. Katie Beleznay already has strong authority, brand recognition, and credibility in the Vancouver market. The opportunity is to better translate that authority into stronger organic visibility, better treatment-page performance, and more consultation inquiries. Based on my review, there is a clear opportunity to refresh the site's SEO foundation, improve how key treatment pages compete in search, and close the gap between Dr. Katie's site and other high-performing cosmetic dermatology competitors in Vancouver.
objectives: Improve visibility for high-intent treatment searches in Vancouver
Strengthen the website's ability to generate consultations
Identify where competitors are currently winning and close those gaps
Improve the quality and structure of key service pages
Ensure lead capture and inquiry flow are functioning properly

strategy.title: Competitive Gap Analysis
strategy.description: Review Dr. Katie's site against Dr. Shannon Humphrey and other top Vancouver competitors to identify gaps in treatment-page structure, content depth, local targeting, and conversion positioning.

strategy.title: High-Intent SEO Optimization
strategy.description: Refresh and optimize the treatment pages most likely to drive qualified inquiries, with emphasis on local commercial intent and search visibility.

strategy.title: Conversion & Lead Path Improvement
strategy.description: Ensure the site is positioned to turn improved traffic into consultation requests by reviewing forms, inquiry flow, and page-level conversion elements.

keywordAreas.intro: The initial keyword focus will center on high-intent treatment searches with strong local commercial intent in the Vancouver market.

investment.roiContext: This engagement is designed to be practical, measurable, and focused on the right priorities for your practice. SEO is a longer-term play — the goal in this sprint is to lay the right foundation, optimize the pages most likely to drive consultation bookings, and generate clear early signals of momentum before deciding on next steps.
investment.exitClause: No long-term lock-in. I recommend a 3–4 month term to allow enough time to see meaningful results, but I'm happy to discuss a month-to-month arrangement after the initial sprint.

caseStudies.description: $630,574 in revenue generated in 7 months vs. $58,306 the prior year. 538+ keywords ranked. Built from near-zero organic presence to market dominance in a competitive niche.
Scaled from $1,699/mo to $23,479/mo in 7 months. 7.57x ROAS on best-performing campaign. Achieved in a competitive niche with limited advertising options.
5.52x average ROAS across 7 campaigns. Grew email revenue from $0 to $45K/month. Full-funnel approach combining paid social with lifecycle email marketing.

nextSteps.closing: I'm ready to get started. The next step is a short call to align on priorities, confirm access to the website and Google Search Console, and kick off the Month 1 audit. The sooner we start, the sooner we can close the gap on Dr. Shannon Humphrey and get Dr. Katie's treatment pages ranking where they should be.
